findings.title: The cutover compatibility test is green before submission but fails after the lawful R03 archival projection
findings.reproduction: Run `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest -v tests.foundation.test_taskctl_schema tests.foundation.test_taskctl_workflow` at frozen submission state 4ff20d8706eeeee698ccdde0ff8a562ef265c056. The suite runs 102 tests and fails `test_current_bootstrap_remediation_requires_its_persisted_authority_scope` at line 3849. Its assertion requires every archived W1.A05 bootstrap attempt to omit `scope_base_commit`. That is true in the pre-submit candidate tree, where only pre-cutover R01/R02 are archived, but the lawful R04 resubmission archives R03. R03 candidate e886dd196e767b52ec253ce5286a0064d5a59c2f is the cutover itself and correctly persists `scope_base_commit=cf8a2568a29766c27a0f73cfb9036d86f91b62ac`; the test therefore rejects the exact history the new control is designed to require.
findings.requiredRemediation: Make the compatibility assertion classify immutable attempts by candidate ancestry against BOOTSTRAP_SCOPE_CONTROL_CUTOVER: pre-cutover R01/R02 remain valid without a fabricated field, while R03 and every later remediation must retain the exact prior-candidate field. Keep current omission, wrong-value, review-entry, and hidden-prefix denials. Rerun the complete taskctl schema/workflow suite after the new submission state is frozen, not only before the resubmission projection.

R01 remains closed and the protected live witness was not accessed.
